02 / THE PERSON BEHIND THE PIXELS

Creative instinct.
Technical curiosity.

I work at the intersection of storytelling, generative AI, and digital discovery.

From building character arcs and immersive environments to designing AI workflows and improving search visibility, I’m interested in what happens when creative thinking meets a system that makes it possible.

My foundation is a B.Tech in Artificial Intelligence & Data Science at Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow (2022–2026).
